fields.Name: T188 - Users Card Expand Details and Roles
fields.Description: Tests the accordion-style expand of user cards revealing per-user stats + assigned-roles lookup (toggleUserExpansion/getUserRoles) — bespoke inline detail rendering, not a record form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'Users' sub-section. Click on a user card header (not its checkbox) to expand it. Verify the expanded panel reveals user details — a stats section (Type, Full Name, Created, Updated) and an 'Assigned Roles' section listing the user's roles (or a 'No roles assigned' message). Click the header again to collapse it. Success is the card expanding to show the details/roles sections and collapsing again. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a user card header expands it to reveal a stats section (Type / Full Name / Created / Updated) and an 'Assigned Roles' section (roles list or 'No roles assigned')
Clicking the header again collapses the card
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
